name: Player
definition: A football player represented once in the Player table and identified by player_api_id. Carries identity and physical demographics only; ability measures live in dated attribute records.
scope: Player-level analysis: identity, demographics, and joins to dated FIFA attribute records.

name: Player API Identifier
definition: The database-native numeric identifier of a player; unique within the Player table.
scope: Primary join key between Player and Player_Attributes, and the value stored in the Match home_player_N and away_player_N slots.

name: Player Reference in Player Attributes
definition: The player identifier carried on each Player_Attributes record, pointing back to the player it describes.
scope: Used to attach a dated attribute snapshot to its player.

name: Player Name
definition: The full display name of a player held in a single text field, given name first and family name last.
scope: Identity filters such as exact full-name lookup or given-name prefix search. Names are not unique across players.

name: Player Birthday
definition: The player's date of birth, stored with a zero time component.
scope: Age and cohort filters such as players born before or after a given year.

name: Player Height
definition: The player's physical height expressed in centimetres.
scope: Physical comparisons such as the tallest or shortest players.

name: Player Attribute Record
definition: A date-stamped FIFA attribute snapshot describing one player at one point in time; holds overall rating, individual skill scores and work rates.
scope: The source of all per-player skill and rating measures. One player has between 2 and 56 records, so most measures must be aggregated or pinned to a date.

name: Overall Rating
definition: FIFA's composite current-ability score for a player inside one attribute snapshot, expressed as an integer.
scope: Ability comparisons, single-snapshot lookups and averages across a player's snapshots.

name: Player Skill Attribute
definition: A single FIFA skill score for a player inside one attribute snapshot, such as finishing, volleys, dribbling, crossing or short passing.
scope: Skill-threshold filters and skill-based comparisons across snapshots.

name: Attacking Work Rate
definition: A categorical descriptor of how strongly a player pushes forward and joins attacking moves in a snapshot.
scope: Player role filters such as identifying players who tend to attack. Stored as a text category, not a number.

name: Defensive Work Rate
definition: A categorical descriptor of how strongly a player holds position and defends while the team attacks in a snapshot.
scope: Player role filters such as identifying players who stay back and defend. Stored as a text category, not a number.

name: Team
definition: A football club represented once in the Team table, identified by team_api_id and optionally by the FIFA identifier team_fifa_api_id.
scope: Team-level analysis: naming, identity, fixtures and tactical attribute snapshots.

name: Team API Identifier
definition: The database-native numeric identifier of a team; unique within the Team table.
scope: Primary join key linking Team to Team_Attributes and to the home and away team slots of Match.

name: Team FIFA API Identifier
definition: The FIFA-supplied numeric identifier of a team, distinct from the database-native team_api_id and not interchangeable with it.
scope: Used when a question asks specifically for the FIFA identifier of a team. Not unique and not always present.

name: Team Reference in Team Attributes
definition: The team identifier carried on each Team_Attributes record, pointing back to the team it describes.
scope: Used to attach a dated tactical attribute snapshot to its team.

name: FIFA Team Reference in Team Attributes
definition: The FIFA team identifier carried on each Team_Attributes record, mirroring the identifier held on Team.
scope: Lets a FIFA team identifier be filtered and returned without leaving the team attribute table.

name: Team Long Name
definition: The full official name of a team.
scope: Reported when a question asks for the name of a team.

name: Team Short Name
definition: A short display code for a team, such as a three-letter abbreviation.
scope: Reported when a question asks for the short name of a team.

name: Team Attribute Record
definition: A date-stamped tactical profile of one team, holding both numeric tactical values and their categorical class labels.
scope: The source of tactical measures such as build-up play and chance creation. Recorded only at a small number of fixed snapshot dates per team.

name: Build-up Play Speed
definition: A numeric tactical score describing how quickly a team advances the ball during build-up play.
scope: Numeric range filters on a team's tactical profile; the companion class label is a separate concept.

name: Build-up Play Passing
definition: A numeric tactical score describing how much a team passes the ball during build-up play.
scope: Numeric thresholds and above-average comparisons on a team's tactical profile.

name: Chance Creation Passing
definition: A numeric tactical score describing how much a team uses passing to create chances.
scope: Numeric thresholds and comparisons on a team's attacking profile.

name: Team Attribute Class Label
definition: The categorical companion label of a numeric team tactical value, produced by splitting the value range into low, middle and high bands. Each tactical dimension names its three bands differently.
scope: Categorical filters on team tactics. The band labels are attribute-specific and their ordering is not obvious: the band boundaries are shared across all dimensions but the words differ.

name: League
definition: A domestic football competition, named with a country prefix, belonging to exactly one country.
scope: Competition-level grouping of matches and seasons.

name: Country
definition: A country that hosts one or more leagues; each league belongs to exactly one country.
scope: Geographic grouping above the league level.

name: Match
definition: A single fixture between a home team and an away team in a league and season, identified by match_api_id, and carrying the two goal totals.
scope: Fixture-level analysis: results, goal totals, match counting and league standings inputs.

name: Season
definition: The competition season a match belongs to, written as two slash-separated years spanning a European football year.
scope: Seasonal grouping of matches. Ordinary year phrases in questions map onto the European season spelling.

name: Home Team
definition: The team playing at its own ground in a fixture, holding the home role in that match.
scope: Role-specific team analysis within a fixture, such as home advantage and home-side goals.

name: Away Team
definition: The team playing away from its own ground in a fixture, holding the away role in that match.
scope: Role-specific team analysis within a fixture, such as away wins and away-side goals.

name: Team Goals in a Match
definition: The number of goals a team scored in a single fixture. The same measure is stored twice per match, once from each side's perspective.
scope: Goal totals, goal-based aggregates and result determination.

name: Match Result
definition: The outcome of a fixture from one team's point of view, obtained by comparing that team's goals with the opponent's goals; expresses win, draw or loss.
scope: Win and loss counts per team, including away wins, where the comparison is made from the away side's perspective.

name: Match Count
definition: The number of fixtures that fall inside a grouping such as a league and season.
scope: Volume comparison across leagues or seasons.
